variants.title: Double slit: wavelength of a helium-neon laser
variants.unknown: the wavelength of the laser light

source.title: He-Ne laser red line: 632.8 nm in air (632.991 nm in vacuum); NIST and ISO 11146

variants.title: Double slit: wavelength of a green laser pointer
variants.unknown: the wavelength of the laser light
variants.note: A green pointer is an infrared laser at 1064 nm whose frequency is doubled, so its line is at exactly half that wavelength.

source.title: Frequency-doubled Nd:YVO4 / Nd:YAG at 1064.1 nm gives 532.05 nm (NIST / laser handbooks)

variants.title: Double slit: wavelength of a red diode laser
variants.unknown: the wavelength of the laser light

source.title: Red AlGaInP laser diode modules are specified at 650 nm nominal (IEC 60825-1 class 2 pointer modules)
